question: Re-read the 24 StanceChangePenalties leaves on the 67 GS files and the HDA H2-H5 / ZDA Field_97ff0ca4 posture rows for M433, M39 EMR and DB-12 on 2.1.1.0; compare with L120/L69 and the site table; propose a posture dimension with a validation glance.

knownAnswerControl.description: M433 GS_HK433 Unzoomed Stand->Prone StanceChangePenalties leaf (index 2) must read the L120 receipt value, and the site M433 standing hip minimum must equal the source standing row. L120 receipt quote (HK433 asset conclusion, build 1.4.3.0): "Unzoomed.StandToProne.Duration=0.8999999761581421; Unzoomed.StandToProne.MinAngleOffset=6.0". Read now on 2.1.1.0: MinAngleOffset 6.0 at 3056, Duration 0.8999999761581421 at 3060 (the L120 control offsets 3216/3220 and 4640 also read 6.0/0.9/0.2). Registry caveat: GRX_Weapons on 2.1.1.0 has no StanceChangePenalties row for GS_HK433 (nor for 52 other site owners); the registry-named rows exist for 14 other site owners and all 360 equal the own value at the index-rule element, which validates the index rule used for M433. Site: data/weapons.json:/[id=m433]/spread/hipStand/0 = 2.432 equals HDA selected row Field_1867639b 2.432 and GS MinMaxDispersion.Unzoomed.Standing.Stationary.MinAngle 2.432.

sourceFacts.siteConsumption: only hipStand/hipMove (HIP_SPREAD_TABLE) and MOVING_ACC_TIERS are read by sim/applyAttachments.js and sim/core.js spreadBounds; Field_b3ab862b, Field_1ef3a223, Field_553bcee0, Field_39b31415 appear only in data/balance_tables.json and docs

inference: MinAngleOffset/Duration naming suggests a transient angular offset after a stance transition; runtime use, composition (additive or replacing) and decay are unproven.

Hip crouch/prone posture labels for H2-H5 rest on the GS-named MinMaxDispersion rows and the L69 Sym crosswalk; the stance-change array is indexed 10 x from + to (L124), confirmed here by 360 registry-named rows.
ADS static minima are posture-independent in the source (ZDA 0.32 in three columns; GS stationary 0.05 in three postures).
unresolved: Runtime activation, composition (additive vs replacing) and decay of the stance-change leaves.
DB-12 GS-named MinMaxDispersion Unzoomed minima (0.784/0.588/0.392) differ from the selected HDA row (2.432/1.824/1.216); same on 1.4.3.5; which one the game uses is unresolved.
ZDA stationary table / GS stationary selector (Field_cee5ebfe) not re-read here; ADS stationary posture values rest on GS-named 0.05 rows.
No GRX_Weapons StanceChangePenalties row for M433 and 52 other site owners on 2.1.1.0 (registry rows exist for 14 owners only); the M433 leaves are joined by the L124 index rule.
No in-game observation yet; proposal depends on the glance.
siteImpact: None today. Conditional: (a) if the in-game glance shows hip crosshair 100/75/50 percent standing/crouch/prone (moving 100/80/60), add a posture selector to the hip spread rows using the existing, unread HIP_SPREAD_TABLE columns Field_b3ab862b/1ef3a223/553bcee0/39b31415 (no new numbers); (b) if a transient widening of about 0.9 s is seen on drop-prone, add the stance-change angle/duration line per weapon (four profiles cover 67 weapons), with additive versus replacing composition decided by the hip peak (7.2 vs 6.0 degrees on the M433); ADS cannot separate the two (static 0.05). No ADS posture selector: static ADS minima are posture-independent in the source. Without the glance the proposal stays source-only.

leads.title: Stance-change penalties and crouch/prone spread minima: posture proposal
leads.summary: On 2.1.1.0 all 67 GS files hold the same 24 StanceChangePenalties leaves as L120 (no change on 63 weapons; MK24 joins the 7-degree outlier group, ELR-40, Z84M and RSPR the 6-degree/0.9 s group), and the HDA/ZDA posture rows still give M433 hip minima of 2.432/1.824/1.216 (100/75/50 percent) while static ADS minima do not vary with posture; a hip posture selector plus a stance-change line is proposed, to be validated by an in-game drop-prone glance.
leads.reopenWhen: a glance shows the hip crosshair ratios and the drop-prone transient (or their absence), settling whether to add a hip posture selector and a stance-change line and which composition reading holds.
leads.statusNote: Posture and stance-change proposal; glance validation pending

assets.question: Does the M433 Unzoomed Stand to Prone StanceChangePenalties leaf still read the L120 value, and what are its posture MinMaxDispersion rows?
assets.conclusion: Control passed: index 2 MinAngleOffset 6.0 at 3056 and Duration 0.9 at 3060; L120 offsets 3216/3220/4640 read 6.0/0.9/0.2. Hip MinMaxDispersion minima 2.432 (stand), 1.824 (crouch), 1.216 (prone), moving 3.04/2.432/1.824; Zoomed stationary 0.05 in all postures.

assets.question: Do HDA rows H2-H5 for the M433, M39 EMR and DB-12 selected rows match the site table columns on 2.1.1.0?
assets.conclusion: Raw hash equals 1.4.3.5. Selected rows (M433 and DB-12 row 3 at 664, M39 EMR row 2 at 504) give H2-H5 of 1.824/2.432/1.216/1.824 and 2.514/3.352/1.676/2.514; all 18 site table rows equal the 18 HDA rows; ratios 0.75/0.5/0.8/0.6 over every row.

assets.question: Do the ZDA posture columns (Field_6c73f45b, Field_624b1a88, Field_97ff0ca4) differ by posture on 2.1.1.0?
assets.conclusion: Raw hash equals 1.4.3.5. Row 3 (selected by all three weapons) holds 0.32 in all three posture columns and 1.13 in Field_bd300f62; the three columns are equal in each of the 7 rows.

assets.question: Do DB-12 GS-named hip minima match the HDA row its selector picks?
assets.conclusion: No: GS MinMaxDispersion Unzoomed stationary stand/crouch/prone read 0.784/0.588/0.392 while the selected HDA row (selector 3) holds 2.432/1.824/1.216; the same GS value was present on 1.4.3.5. Which the game uses is unresolved.

assets.question: What StanceChangePenalties values does the Season 5 MK24 hold?
assets.conclusion: Profile C: Unzoomed Stand to Prone 7.0 deg / 0.9 s, Crouch to Prone 7.0 / 0.6, Prone to Stand 3.0 / 0.8, Stand/Crouch 0.2 deg / 0.3 s; the registry has two identical rows per leaf and both equal the own value.

assets.question: Which GS owners have registry-named StanceChangePenalties rows and do they agree with the own leaves at the L124 index rule?
assets.conclusion: 360 rows on 14 site owners equal the own value at index 10 x from + to (+100 zoomed); GS_HK433 and 52 other site owners have no such row.
